关闭时使用单线程搜索；2–16 是并行上限，实际并发还会受可独立分支数和内存安全: Off uses one thread. Values 2–16 cap parallel workers; actual concurrency depends on independent branches and safe memory capacity, so CPU usage may stay below 100%. Higher values may speed up large searches but increase CPU, memory and frame pressure. Gains above physical core count are usually small. Defaults to 8 threads with 16 or more available logical processors, 4 with 4–15, 2 with 2–3, and 1 otherwise. If parallel search seems faulty, upload a report before switching it off.
开启时按下方预算建立战斗级 NoGC 区域，在安全分配检查点整理内存后继续；最终: Reserve a combat-level NoGC region within the budget below. Reclaim memory at safe allocation checkpoints and continue searching. Keep the region after search and clean up shortly after combat. When off, use normal CLR garbage collection. Applies to the next search.
这是独立于性能预设的战斗级 NoGC 区域请求上限，不是进程总内存上限，也不等于: Upper bound for the combat NoGC region, independent of the preset. This is neither a total process limit nor actual resident memory. The solver lowers the reservation to fit safe system headroom. More memory supports more parallel branches and fewer cleanup pauses, but increases memory and paging pressure. Near the allocation or system safety limit, search retains the active beam, reclaims memory and continues. Cleanup occurs after combat.
搜索达到该时间后停止当前阶段。提高后可搜索更久，可能找到更好路线，也会更晚显示结: Stop the current phase at this time limit. Higher values allow more exploration but delay results. Fast search provides an initial plan; deep search improves it.
每层保留的候选路线数量。提高后更不容易过早淘汰好路线，但会明显增加计算量和内存占: Number of candidate routes kept per layer. Higher values preserve more alternatives but increase computation and memory use.
单次搜索最多展开的状态数量。提高后搜索范围更大，也会增加耗时和内存占用。: Maximum states expanded per search. Higher values broaden exploration and increase time and memory use.
每个状态最多继续尝试的出牌动作数量。提高后能覆盖更多出牌顺序，但会放大后续搜索量: Maximum card actions explored from each state. Higher values cover more play orders but multiply later search work.
